messages:
anya: Heads up — heavy hail on westbound 101 by Millbrae. Anyone rerouting? 
commute-bot: FYI: Caltrain 8:12 from SFO delayed ~22m due to signal work (https://caltrain.com/status).
sam: Ugh my car's in the splash zone, taking 92 -> 280 detour. If you see a slow white Prius with two soggy dogs, that's me. :sweat_smile:
taylor: BART still weird but moving. Platform at 16th is packed; found a spot near the door. Bring headphones if you want to zone out.
leila: Ferry announced 10m delay, captain said something about 'extra wind'. Good excuse to get bakery croissant from the terminal. Anyone want a pastry run? :croissant:
omar: @leila yes please. Also heads up — parking lot at the office has standing water by the north entrance, bring waterproof shoes.
marta: Quick poll — umbrella, rain jacket, or full-on rain boots? Reply with emoji: :thumbsup: umbrella, :heart: rain jacket, :tada: boots
anya: :thumbsup: umbrella (I can't commit to clomping around in boots but will consider rain jacket)
sam: :tada: boots, my sneakers are ruined last time and I learned my lesson
taylor: :heart: rain jacket — layering is life.
leila: Also — if you're switching from ferry to BART, expect a slow shuffle at Embarcadero. Plan +10m.
commute-bot: Reminder: ferry shuttle service running on modified route today due to lane closures. See internal travel page for map.
omar: If anyone's leaving after 6 and wants to carpool from SoMa, ping me. I have room for two.
marta: Thanks for the offers! If the hail gets worse I might work from home tomorrow. Stay dry out there everyone :umbrella_with_rain_drops:
